QuestInfo.name: [Evolution System] Vanished Orchid
QuestInfo.0: You got an urgent call from Claudine in #m310010000#. See what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: You got an urgent call from Claudine. She needs you to halt all your missions and come to the Resistance's Secret Plaza. Go talk to Claudine to figure out what is going on.
QuestInfo.2: You went to the Resistance Secret Plaza to answer Claudine's urgent call. She says Commander Orchid has disappeared.

0.msg: #h0#, this is an emergency. Put everything else on hold and meet me at the Resistance Secret Plaza.

no.0: I'd like to remind you that this is urgent. Return to headquarters at once.

1.0: You're finally here. Good. I'll cut to the chase. #rCommander Orchid is... gone.#k It's... all our fault.

yes.0: Orchid was refusing to eat or drink a thing. She wanted to find Lotus, and I guess she was worried or something. We foolishly let our guard down because she seemed so weak.
